notes.title: Ultimate Physics Manipulator
notes.body: An embedded physics studio with 32 live controls, six impulse axes and 12 playground presets. Tune gravity, simulation speed, real wind, mass, structural beams, friction and force fields.

notes.title: Customs and Physics studio transitions
notes.body: Smooth sci-fi entrance and exit animations when moving in and out of either embedded studio. Your animation preference and reduced-motion setting are respected.

notes.title: Restore your experiments
notes.body: Restore the session’s world settings and vehicle coefficients. Emergency recovery, vehicle reset, connection loss and closing the trainer end the active physics session.

notes.title: Delivered through your live updater
notes.body: Download, verify and upgrade in place. Your cockpit preferences stay saved and the animated changelog introduces this release.
